title: Detailed fire truck
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- ground shadow -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='86' rx='42' ry='5' fill='#3a2a4a'/>
  <!-- ladder -->
  <rect x='30' y='14' width='52' height='4' fill='#c8d8ee'/>
  <rect x='30' y='22' width='52' height='4' fill='#c8d8ee'/>
  <rect x='32' y='12' width='3' height='16' fill='#9fb4d6'/>
  <rect x='44' y='12' width='3' height='16' fill='#9fb4d6'/>

  <rect x='68' y='12' width='3' height='16' fill='#9fb4d6'/>
  <rect x='79' y='12' width='3' height='16' fill='#9fb4d6'/>
  <!-- cab body -->
  <path d='M12 60 L12 40 Q12 34 18 34 L44 34 L44 60 Z' fill='#e23b3b'/>
  <path d='M12 60 L12 40 Q12 34 18 34 L44 34 L44 60 Z' fill='none' stroke='#ff8080' stroke-width='1.5'/>

  <path d='M18 40 L30 40 L30 48 L18 48 Z' fill='#8fd4ff'/>

  <rect x='12' y='56' width='74' height='5' fill='#f7f0e8'/>

  <rect x='48' y='47' width='14' height='8' fill='#c02828'/>
  <rect x='65' y='47' width='17' height='8' fill='#c02828'/>
  <rect x='48' y='47' width='14' height='8' fill='none' stroke='#ff9a9a' stroke-width='1'/>
  <rect x='65' y='47' width='17' height='8' fill='none' stroke='#ff9a9a' stroke-width='1'/>
  <!-- beacon on cab -->
  <rect x='22' y='30' width='10' height='4' rx='2' fill='#ffcc33'/>
  <circle cx='27' cy='29' r='3' fill='#ffe27a'/>

  <rect x='58' y='38' width='8' height='4' rx='2' fill='#ffcc33'/>

  <circle cx='28' cy='70' r='11' fill='#2b2b38'/>

  <circle cx='28' cy='70' r='4.5' fill='#c8d8ee'/>
  <circle cx='66' cy='70' r='11' fill='#2b2b38'/>
  <circle cx='66' cy='70' r='11' fill='none' stroke='#6a6a88' stroke-width='2'/>
  <circle cx='66' cy='70' r='4.5' fill='#c8d8ee'/>
  <!-- headlight -->
  <circle cx='15' cy='62' r='3.5' fill='#ffe9a8'/>
  <!-- bumper -->
  <rect x='10' y='66' width='8' height='4' rx='1.5' fill='#9fb4d6'/>
  <!-- ladder base rail -->
  <rect x='44' y='38' width='42' height='3' fill='#9fb4d6'/>
